verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing bullet points about memory capacity, display outputs, codec support, and software ecosystem — no published TFLOPS/TOPS figures broken out by precision (FP16/FP8/INT8/FP4) or with/without sparsity are cited anywhere. Community threads discuss pricing, power draw, and hardware defects but never cite or dispute throughput specs, so there's nothing to size training/inference workloads from.
